description: To when a stored copy may be served when later fetches fail, by its product's own validity (FAA-H-8083-28B 24.4.1, 26.2-26.3, 27.4.1): METARs no limit, TAFs and SIGMETs to the end of their valid time, PIREPs 90 minutes after the newest, G-AIRMETs 90 minutes after the last snapshot; a copy that says nothing three hours from its fetch. Unix seconds.
